text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM thread. Moss's notes have two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md, dated 5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed it was working the next morning.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was sent to tier-2 support for firmware testing. The note has no date, so I told Dana I can't say how current that status is.

I read all six of Moss's files, which are public, so Dana can see them. The other four don't list any Quarrendon tickets. The two Central notes list #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those belong to Central team accounts, not Quarrendon. I also left out Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer.

Other North team pages have more Quarrendon ticket numbers. Since she asked only about Moss's notes, I didn't list those and offered to pull them if she wants. I didn't include any pricing or contract terms.
